notes: Charts and pictures in reports: paste a chart from Excel with Ctrl+V right between your bullets, add bar charts or pictures from the toolbar, and drag a corner to resize them.
Charts in Reports: add bar charts like sales by customer, paste the numbers straight from Excel, and next week's report keeps them.
New Style picker in Reports: choose Daybook, Modern, Corporate (with a 결재 sign-off box) or Minimal for your report's look.
New bell next to the search bar shows what's still coming up today and over the next week.
Short tasks are centered in their boxes and no longer hide behind each other.
Week view: task circles now line up with their titles.
Korean language option in Settings. Checks for updates every hour.
Updates install without a stuck command window.
Shorter, clearer wording on the Market and Settings pages.
